name: Hexoptics C44

passives.name: Magnification
passives.effects: Deal 0% – 10% (based on distance to target) increased basic damage. The distance is calculated from the edge of your current position to edge of the target's position at the time they are damaged.

passives.name: Arcane Aim
passives.effects: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them grants you 100 bonus attack range for 8 seconds.

description:
55 Attack Damage
25% Critical Strike Chance

Magnification

Arcane Aim
When a champion that you damaged within 3 seconds dies, gain 100 additional attack range for 8 seconds.
